item-interactions-using-a-piece-of-meat-.text: You give the dog a nice piece of meat. It gobbles it up.

item-interactions-using-shaikahan-bones-.text: That's disgusting - you can't give it to the poor dog!

item-interactions-using-alan-s-bones-on-.text: You give the dog Alan's bones. It happily gnaws on them, but something feels wrong about all of this.

item-interactions-using-any-other-item-o.text: The dog doesn't seem interested in that.
